test_scenario: Submit a standard request with the service address blank
expected_result: Submission is blocked and the missing field is identified.

test_scenario: Create two valid requests in sequence
expected_result: Each request receives a different immutable request ID.
The request appears in the high-priority coordinator queue within one minute.

test_scenario: Remove the owner from an active request
expected_result: The system blocks the change or reassigns the request within the configured interval.

test_scenario: Attempt to schedule a request without verified contact information
expected_result: The status change is blocked and missing information is displayed.
A confirmation containing the correct request ID and next step is logged.

test_scenario: Change a request from Scheduled to Rescheduled
expected_result: The configured customer notification and audit entry are created.

test_scenario: Open an assigned request as a technician
expected_result: One job summary displays all approved service and access fields.

test_scenario: Load the dashboard using a controlled test dataset
expected_result: Displayed KPIs match independently calculated expected values.

test_scenario: Attempt to open administrative settings as a technician
expected_result: Access is denied and the attempt is handled according to security policy.

test_scenario: Measure 100 representative request and queue page loads
expected_result: At least 95 loads complete within three seconds.

column7: The audit history records user, timestamp, and before-and-after values for each change.
